description: Defines the CKEDITOR.dom.domObject class, a base class for DOM object representations in CKEditor, including event handling, custom data storage, and unique identification.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.domObject
classes.description: A base class representing a DOM object, providing event handling, custom data, and unique ID functionality.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal based on the underlying DOM node.

methods.name: setCustomData
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair as custom data associated with this DOM object.

methods.name: getCustomData
methods.description: Retrieves custom data stored with a specific key.

methods.name: removeCustomData
methods.description: Removes custom data associated with a specific key.

methods.name: clearCustomData
methods.description: Removes all custom data and event listeners from the object.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this DOM object.
